trainers.instruction: Look at the image below of Joe playing golf and answer the questions. The arrows show the distance between Joe and the hole in equal parts.

trainers.instruction: Look at the image below of Dan doing the long jump and answer the questions. The arrows show the distance between 8 and 10 metres in equal parts along the measuring tape.

atoms.a: What fraction does each arrow represent?
What fraction of the given distance has Dan managed to jump?
How many more quarters would Dan need to jump to reach 10m?
